simple.meaning: נְגַד (nᵉgad) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to flow (through the idea of clearing the way).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.

definitions.short: to flow (through the idea of clearing the way)
definitions.full: H5047. negad [ נְגַד ] verb stream, flow ( נְגַד ᵑ7 , Syriac draw along, lead , ᵑ7 also intransitive move along Isa 30:24 , flow Deut 33:13 , 22 , נַגְדִּין streams Isa 44:4 +); — Pe`al Participle Dan 7:10 מִןקֳֿדָמוֺהִי וְנָפֵק נגֵד דִּי נְהַר .

occurrences.englishText: A fiery stream issued and came out from before him.
